posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
Today, I made the somewhat difficult decision to ban Envisioner from the Greater Than Games forum for repeated and flagrant violation of the Official Forum Rules, most notably:

1. Be respectful
 
3. Stay relatively on topic
 
4. Obey the Admins
 
5. Obey the mods
 
6. Keep cursing to a minimum
 
14. Be respectful
 
 
While we appreciate every fan of the game, we also feel a responsability to this forum community and a desire to have the most awesome community we can, complete with healthy discourse. If anyone has any questions or concerns about this issue, please contact me privately at paul@greaterthangames.com.

posts.cooked: Due to the preponderance of evidence from forum dialogue, private messages, and digital examination, we have been convinced that Edwin was in fact the same person as Envisioner. As a consequence, the Edwin account has also been banned.
